newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: High bid in Taiwan diesel tender around $25.50/bbl.
newsitem.headline: High bid in Taiwan diesel tender around $25.50/bbl.

text.p: The highest bid in Taiwanese state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp's (CPC) tender to buy diesel was slightly over $25.50 per barrel on a free-on-board (fob) basis to Kaohsiung, a CPC source said on Tuesday.
The 225,000-to-250,000-barrel cargo of 0.3 percent sulphur diesel was tendered for September 23-30 lifting.
Traders said the best, out of a total of seven bids, was made by a European major oil company.
The tender closed on August 26 and offers are valid until Wednesday, the CPC source said.
In its last tender, CPC sold 225,000-250,000 barrels of diesel near $24.50 per barrel for August 23-30 lifting, fob Kaohsiung.
